data.name: Glider Configurator
data.shortDescription: Allows you to customize the flight settings of the glider.
data.description:
Ever wanted to fly at lightspeed or perhaps you feel gliders are a bit too op? This mod has got you covered. This mod allows you to configure every important setting associated with glider flight.  See Mods>Configs for more details.

- You can configure the following:

- You can configure the following:

- Downward Pitch Strength

- Constant Downward Force

- Forward Glide Speed

- Forward Momentum Retention

- Heading Stabilization

- Steering Responsiveness

- Ground Detach Height

- Initial Lift Boost

- Maximum Wind Audio Speed

- Pitch Angle Limits

- Tilt Angle Limits

- Pitch Control Speed

- Tilt Stabilization

- Tilt Control Speed

- Tilt Rotation Strength

- Glide Activation Delay

- Upward Pitch Resistance

- Overall Velocity Damping

Multiplayer:

Not tested, but probably client side.
